title: Field Service Software Cost: 1 User vs 5 Users (2026)
description: What Jobber, Housecall Pro, Kickserv, QuoteIQ, LawnPro and 8 more cost for 1 user vs 5 users, from published prices. Assumptions shown. Oct 2026.
h1: Field service software cost for 1 user vs 5 users
keyword: field service software cost per user
body:
Updated 2026-10-26. Most field service software is sold by plan, and plans include a set number of users. A price that looks cheap for one owner-operator can jump when you add a crew. This table shows what each tool we cover costs for 1 user and for 5 users, using only prices published on each vendor's own pricing page (as recorded on each tool page; LawnPro checked 2026-10-26). Where a vendor doesn't publish a price or a per-user rate, we write unknown and don't estimate it.

How we worked it out

  • "User" means anyone who needs their own login (owner, office staff, field techs). Vendors name these differently (users, employee logins, providers, mobile licenses, sub-users); the notes column says which.
  • For each headcount we pick the cheapest published plan that includes that many users, or a lower plan plus published extra-user fees when the vendor says extra users can be added to it. The only computed figure is QuoteIQ (plan price + $25/mo extra user).
  • Prices are per month before tax, card processing fees and add-ons. "Annual" means the monthly rate when billed annually; "monthly" means no-commitment monthly billing.
  • Feature differences between plans are not priced in: the cheapest 5-user plan may lack features you need. Check each tool page.
  • Time-limited promos (for example Jobber's promo pricing ending Oct 30, 2026) are left out.

Sources: each tool's vendor pricing page, linked on its tool page. "unknown" = not published. Checked 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26.

What stands out

  • Flat for a crew: Kickserv ($60/mo annual), GorillaDesk ($49/mo, 1 route), BookingKoala (from $27/mo) and Skimmer (per pool) cost the same at 1 or 5 users.
  • Free for one, paid for five: LawnPro (free → $129/mo) and ResponsiBid (free → $179/mo).
  • Biggest jump: Service Autopilot goes from $49/mo to $499/mo (annual rates) because extra mobile license prices aren't published.
  • Jobber vs Housecall Pro at 5 users: both $149/mo billed annually (Connect 5-user vs Essentials).

faq: Which field service software is cheapest for 5 users?

Of published prices checked 2026-10-24 to 2026-10-26: BookingKoala Starter from $27/mo (5 providers), GorillaDesk Basic $49/mo for 1 route with unlimited users, Skimmer from $49/mo (priced per pool), and Kickserv Start $60/mo billed annually ($75 monthly) with 5 users included.
How much does Jobber cost for 5 users?
Jobber lists a 5-user Connect tier at $149/mo billed annually or $199/mo monthly, and 5-user Grow at $229/mo annually or $299/mo monthly (checked 2026-10-26, excluding the promo ending Oct 30, 2026).
Which tools don't publish per-user pricing?

Workiz publishes no plan prices. Yardbook doesn't publish user limits or per-user prices. Housecall Pro, Kickserv, LawnPro, LMN and Service Autopilot don't publish an extra-user price below their top tiers (Housecall Pro lists $35/mo per extra user on MAX).
